culture.en: Ancient Naxi Kingdom — Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, Lijiang Old Town & Dongba Culture. A thousand-year-old water city at 2,400m altitude.
culture.zh: 纳西古王国 — 玉龙雪山、丽江古城与东巴文化。2400 米高原千年水城。

climate.en: Mild plateau climate (10-20°C). Best Apr-Jun and Sep-Oct; avoid July-Aug rains.
climate.zh: 高原温和气候（10-20°C）。4-6月、9-10月最佳；避开7-8月雨季。

transit.en: Buses within old town; Lijiang Airport 30km. Walkable ancient town.
transit.zh: 古城内步行/公交；丽江机场30公里。古城可步行。

intercity.zh: 昆明高铁约3小时、大理约2小时。

tips.en: Stay in Shuhe for quieter vibe; Jade Dragon Snow Mountain needs warm layers.
tips.zh: 想安静住束河；玉龙雪山需保暖衣物。
